5:01pm: A brilliant steady-the-ship effort from Hope and Carty not only rescued West 
Indies from 91 for 4 but took them to a win without further harm. It was set up by the 
spinners, Joseph and Seales earlier. Mayers was at his exuberant best early on in the 
chase. That was before Thakur lorded into the scene. He got the bouncer right to 
Mayers, capitalised on King being stuck on the back foot and had him lbw, and then did 
Athanaze in with another bouncer. When Hetmyer, who was all at sea against spin, was 
dismissed by Kuldeep, India seemed to have gotten back into ascendancy. But Carty 
and Hope toughed it out against the pacy spin of Jadeja and Axar and the loopier variety 
from Kuldeep. They ran diligently and rotated strike to whittle the target. Hope got past 
fifty with the end in sight. The duo got through Thakur and Hardik's last crack and Carty 
narrowly missed out on fifty but saw West Indies through to their first win against India 
in over three years. 
JD: "two contrasting last 91 runs for each team" 
Hardik Pandya, India captain: We didn't bat the way we were supposed to. The wicket 
was better than it was in the first game. Everyone barring Shubman hit fielders and got 
out. Disappointing but many things to learn. The way our openers batted, especially 
Ishan, struck it well and is good for India. Shardul got us back in with his bowling. Hope 
and Carty batted well and got them through. Body's fine. I have to bowl more overs and 
get my workload up for the World Cup. I'm a turtle right now not the rabbit and hoping 
everything goes right as the World Cup comes on. To be honest, you want to be going 1-
1 to the third game as it'll be more challenging and exciting. 
Shai Hope, POTM and WI captain: I'm happy as long as my contributions lead to the 
win. When things are difficult, you gotta find ways to score quickly. So you gotta run 
hard, we got twos which helped. Very satisfied, the aim was to get back to the series. 
We gotta win one more and need to come back strongly. We gotta put in the effort and 
today we displayed the right attitude, need to replicate that in all disciplines. It was a 
complete performance. We want to tick the boxes and get the right result in the final 
game. 
A decider we wants and a decider we gets thanks to West Indies' resilience on display 
today. You can comb through what happened in Himanshu Agrawal's match report up 
here. So, let's continue to hope and pun along for the showdown in Trinidad in a couple 
of days. Sudarshanan will join Abhimanyu, who'll return on comms. I'm Ekanth, signing 
on behalf of Abhimanyu Bose, and our scorers, Chandan Duorah and Ranjith P.
